synthetic_graph.dependencies: For i > 0, sorted unique max(0, i-1), max(0, i-10), max(0, i-50). Each exported F() int returns 1 plus the sum of dependency F() calls. p0000.F returns 1. main imports fmt and p0999 and prints p0999.F().

fixture_rebuilds.scope: Rebuild every package with nix-build --check; warm tools, sources, and dependency outputs. No network transfer.

synthetic_rebuilds.scope: Rebuild every package with nix-build --check; warm tools, sources, and dependency outputs. No network transfer.

dynamic_fresh_planner.scope: dynamic evaluation + realization; fresh planner, warm tools and Go package outputs; no network transfer

worker_closures.scope: Sum of NAR and zstd level 3 file sizes for complete closures; local binary cache, no network timing

iets_dynamic_validation.scope: Warm evaluation with tracing cache disabled; real daemon builds with IFD and classic fallback disabled. Nested planning uses iets too.

iets_large_graph_evaluation.scope: Warm graph evaluation; no builds; iets tracing cache and Nix fallback disabled

validation.native_buildid: All 67 fixture outputs were unchanged when rewritten again with the original pinned cmd/buildid tool.

upm.scope: Sandboxed standalone build and CLI smoke tests; not the full upstream integration suite.

limits: Rebuild benchmarks use nix-build --check for every package with warm tools, sources and dependency outputs. They are not cold-store or network-transfer timings.
Binary-cache sizes are zstd level 3 payload sums in a local file cache. No remote transfer latency or throughput was measured.
Pure worker closures shrink substantially; the planning bundle grows because it retains the SDK plus the copied worker tools.
Fresh dynamic planning with cached package outputs was roughly flat (10.70s before, 10.89s after), including some slower after samples.
The two evaluator benchmarks have different scopes: dynamic wrapper evaluation imports nixpkgs; exported graph evaluation does not. Worker count is not monotonically faster.
Debug information and per-package cache granularity are preserved. Recipe changes require a one-time package rebuild.

instrumented_planner.scope: One diagnostic run, not an alternating benchmark; remaining realization time was not attributed.
